meta.title: Mira - Your next hire is already out there.
meta.envNote: Original explore was against the Railway preview deployment above (5 official skills). Verified live on production (https://mira.day/settings/skills, redirects to https://www.mira.day/settings/skills) on the same date: Official tab shows 4 skills (skill-creator, talent-mapping, salary-report, candidate-summary) — a genuine content/config difference between environments, not a locator regression. TC-CDP-SKILL-001/005 assertions were made count-agnostic / name-agnostic (derive expected count from the tab's own count badge; derive a sample skill name from the first rendered switch) so they pass against either environment.

conditionalElements.description: Replaces the whole list view; only reachable for source='system' (official) skills via SkillRow onSelect — but SkillRow renders official rows as a plain non-interactive div (no onClick wiring), so in the current implementation this inline detail view is not actually reachable by clicking an official row. Personal/marketplace skills instead navigate to /settings/skills/[name] via router.push, bypassing this component. Not a bug — intentional per inline code comment '官方不可点击'.

No icon, t('empty.personal.title/description') + CTA button — observed live, this account has 0 personal skills
4-row skeleton placeholder while GET /api/skills resolves — not captured (resolved before snapshot, page was already hydrated/idle)
Mobile renders a bottom Drawer with the same 2 options; desktop renders a DropdownMenu. Explored desktop variant only (viewport was desktop-sized)
Toggle switch is disabled when skill.accessible is false; all 5 official skills observed were accessible/enabled

S1.notes: URL updated to ?tab=personal via history.replaceState (MIRA-2338: tab switches intentionally do NOT push a history entry, so browser Back skips over tab state and returns to the page visited before /settings/skills). No hydration issue: click took effect immediately, list content genuinely swapped (not an SSR/pre-hydration artifact) per e2e-flakiness-playbook §19b check.

Desktop renders DropdownMenu (viewport was desktop); mobile (useIsMobile) would render a bottom Drawer with identical 2 options — not verified in this pass. Menu closed via Escape, returning to S1 without navigating.

locatorProfile.dominantStrategy: role + name (tabs, buttons, menuitems); aria-label for icon-only Back button and per-skill toggle switches; no data-testid found in settings/skills feature source

knownIssues.description: Not clickable — renders as a plain div, not a button, for source='system' skills (see SkillRow in skills-client.tsx). SkillDetailView / onSelect logic exists in code for official skills but is unreachable via the current UI wiring since the click handler is only bound for non-official rows. Confirmed intentional via inline Chinese comment ('官方不可点击') — flagging for awareness only, not a functional bug.

summary.scrollMode: page-level overflow-auto, list itself not paginated/virtualized (5 items)
summary.coverageNote: Smoke scope only, per task instructions. Not exercised: toggling a skill switch (enable/disable, would mutate real account state), navigating into a personal/marketplace skill detail route (/settings/skills/[name] — no personal skills exist on this account to test with), actually following the 'Import File' entry point into /settings/skills/import, mobile Drawer variant of NewSkillMenu, official-tab empty state (5 official skills exist, so state not observable live), loading skeleton (resolved before first snapshot).
